crossRefs.note: The priest shall cause her to take an oath and shall tell the woman, “If no man has lain with you, and if you haven’t…
But if you have gone astray, being under your husband’s authority, and if you are defiled, and some man has lain with…
to deliver you from the strange woman, even from the foreigner who flatters with her words,
who forsakes the friend of her youth, and forgets the covenant of her God;

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: “Speak to the children of Israel, and tell them: ‘If any man’s wife goes astray and is unfaithful to him,
translations.bsb: “Speak to the Israelites and tell them that if any man’s wife goes astray and is unfaithful to him
translations.kjv: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, If any man's wife go aside, and commit a trespass
translations.asv: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, If any man's wife go aside, and commit a trespass against him,
